guidance: Prefer TP for model sharding, add PP or CP when needed, and coordinate EP/ETP with TP for MoE models.
When memory allows, reduce rollout TP to create more vLLM replicas and improve throughput, while accounting for the extra KV-cache usage.
With dynamic batching, set actor PPO max tokens to at least 2x the maximum sequence length; otherwise, tune the PPO micro-batch size.
Ref log-prob concurrency can be several times higher than rollout log-prob concurrency: tune max tokens with dynamic batching, or micro-batch size otherwise.
